stories.story_fr: Sur l'exercice 2025, les ventes Systemwide aux membres fidelite ont progresse de 20% pour approcher 37 Mds $, et les utilisateurs fidelite actifs sur 90 jours ont augmente de 19% pour atteindre pres de 210 millions a fin d'annee.
stories.story_en: For full year 2025, Systemwide sales to loyalty members increased 20% to nearly $37 billion, with 90-day active loyalty users up 19% to nearly 210 million as of year-end.
stories.signal: Systemwide sales to loyalty members for the full year increased 20% to nearly $37 billion, with 90-day active loyalty users up 19% to nearly 210 million as of year-end

stories.story_fr: Au premier trimestre 2026, le programme de fidelite couvre desormais 70 marches, contre 60 un an plus tot, avec des ventes Systemwide aux membres de plus de 38 Mds $ sur douze mois glissants.
stories.story_en: In the first quarter of 2026, the loyalty program now spans 70 markets, up from 60 a year earlier, with Systemwide sales to loyalty members exceeding $38 billion on a trailing twelve-month basis.
stories.signal: Across 70 loyalty markets, Systemwide sales to loyalty members were over $38 billion for the trailing twelve-month period and over $9 billion for the quarter

stories.story_fr: Sur l'exercice 2025, les ventes Systemwide mondiales ont depasse 139 Mds $, en hausse de 7% (5% en devises constantes), soit une croissance de 9 Mds $ sur l'annee.
stories.story_en: For full year 2025, global Systemwide sales surpassed $139 billion, up 7% (5% in constant currencies), representing growth of $9 billion over the year.
stories.signal: Global Systemwide sales* for the full year increased 7% (5% in constant currencies) to over $139 billion, or growth of $9 billion ($7 billion in constant currencies)
